videos.overview:
A Love story based in a city of West Bengal trapped in old tradition of our society, where a girl sacrifices everything for her love. To become a single soul, both choose a path and soon face the ocean of troubles. While they are trying to handle things, destiny interferes and a well-settled single parent enters in the girl's life showing difference between dreams and reality.
